questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “conjugated diene”?

options.label: A
options.text: The structural unit or conjugated system in a molecule directly responsible for the absorption of specific wavelengths of ultraviolet or visible light.

options.label: B
options.text: A compound containing two carbon–carbon double bonds separated by a single carbon–carbon bond, allowing continuous pi orbital overlap.

options.label: C
options.text: The stereochemical preference in Diels–Alder reactions where dienophile substituents containing pi electrons align toward the developing diene pi system.

options.label: D
options.text: Reaction conditions where the product distribution is determined by the relative thermodynamic stabilities of the products at equilibrium.
